summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of multi-platform AI filmmaker discovery system. All discovery modules (Vimeo, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Web) load correctly, classifiers work as expected, acceptance gates function properly, and all npm scripts are defined.

database_dependencies.issue: Require PostgreSQL database connection to run actual discovery processes
database_dependencies.impact: Cannot execute full discovery workflows without database
database_dependencies.note: This is expected behavior - workers need DB for crawl run tracking

passed_tests: All 6 discovery modules load without errors (Vimeo, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Web)
All API client stubs return correct empty arrays
Vimeo classifier correctly scores AI filmmaker content high (85+ scores)
Vimeo classifier correctly scores tutorial/brand content low (<30 scores)
Acceptance gates correctly accept high-score content (85+)
Acceptance gates correctly reject low-score content (<50)
Blocked creator names functionality works for major AI companies
All npm discovery scripts are properly defined in package.json
Shared utilities (entityUtils, blockedCreatorNames, contactEnrichmentRules, extractContacts) work correctly
Edge cases handled gracefully (null inputs, mixed signals, border cases)
